new_defects_discovered.root_cause: The candidate-table writer reuses the pool address fields for the balances payload. The snapshot writer (write_depth_snapshot, lib.rs:1739-1754) correctly writes human-readable capacity AMOUNTS, but the candidate writer never was migrated.
new_defects_discovered.impact: If refresh_pair or refresh_key runs after depth --apply, dex_candidate_pools.balances_json.token0/token1 become address strings. The next review cycle then raises an uncaught ValueError inside the sizing path, potentially aborting the whole review batch rather than degrading to a fallback. This is worse than the current empty-object state, which degrades safely to None.

design_doc_verdict.overall: Direction is right (chain-side lightweight snapshot arbitration + off-chain full computation + memory/persistence separation), but the proposed DATA LAYER must not be adopted literally.
must_not_do: Do NOT create core_pools / watch_pools dual tables: pool_scope_config is already the scope authority (scope_key + library_checksums_json + materialized_checksum). A second physical pool table introduces exactly the dual-source drift that produced the current pool_scope_drift blocker.
Do NOT use USD thresholds: 86/88 production loops (97.7%) borrow a token that is neither ETH nor a USD stablecoin; 42/88 (47.7%) borrow stock tokens. cap_in_usd is not evaluable on this chain.
Do NOT use TTL DELETE on a watch table: recent_swap_active is NULL for all 4669 snapshot rows, so there is no event-recency signal to base a TTL on yet.
Do NOT claim amountOutMinimum: Uniswap V4 has no amountOutMinimum; the corresponding parameter is sqrtPriceLimitX96.
Do NOT hardcode gasLimit=500000: production broadcast count is 0 and 3-hop flash-loan gas is unmeasured.
Do NOT implement a local tick cache: capacity is determined by (sqrtPriceX96, liquidity, fee); the codebase contains no tickBitmap/tickLiquidityNet.
should_adopt: Keep capacity as the primary admission signal with token-denominated economics (already implemented as economicFloorGate).
Keep the strict separation of 'radar inclusion' from 'execution eligibility' (already implemented: dust_unprofitable closes the execution path only).
Keep U256/integer-only arithmetic for all profit and capacity math (already satisfied).
Adopt the snapshot-vs-recompute arbitration direction, but gate it behind ARCH-2 (off-chain 3-hop simulator parity).
already_satisfied_in_repo: capacity-primary admission SQL with USD only as a tie-breaker (pool_manager/src/lib.rs:996-1023)
shared single-source depth policy (flashloan/config/depth_policy.json, Rust start-up assertion + Python import-time load)
on-chain extsload batch reader with RPC endpoint preflight and fallback (pool_manager/src/chain.rs)
scope-scoped depth refresh with candidate default scope, --resume, --max-pools, --progress-every
D4 capacity-aware ladder start + upward search + token-denominated economic floor (2026-11-12)

recommended_data_layer.principle: Extend the existing authority instead of adding a parallel one.

items.item: Fix D5: after depth --apply, propagate the snapshot balances_json into dex_candidate_pools.balances_json (either a dedicated propagation step in refresh_depth, or change builders.py to read the snapshot).
Fix D6: upsert_eligible_pool_rows must write human-readable capacity AMOUNTS (and the decimals), never token addresses.
Add a single execution_eligible flag per pool, derived from economicFloorGate, instead of deleting rows.
Populate last_chain_event_at from real chain events (WSS/logs) to replace the all-NULL recent_swap_active before any TTL/eviction policy is designed.

Define the Top-K recommendation sort key explicitly (capacityBindingRaw DESC + direction key + pool_id), and reconcile it with the existing is_first_hop_recommended / is_third_hop_recommended flags (currently 100 rows flagged per direction, far above the proposed K=5).

next_actions_requiring_authorization: Fix D5 and D6 in pool_manager (code only, no production write).
Re-run the W6 rehearsal end-to-end on a fresh copy with the corrected candidate propagation, then re-validate '_liquidity_cap_raw() non-None' against dex_candidate_pools (not the snapshot table).
Only then request production write authorization for W6-4.
